name: reaching-arm
prompt: Make a robot arm of two bars, each 0.5 m long and 0.08 m thick, joined end to end with its shoulder at the origin. A small red ball 0.12 m across moves back and forth along a path 0.6 m up and 0.5 m to the side over two seconds, and the arm must always reach for the ball: its end stays on the ball and the elbow bends as the ball moves.

name: grab-and-reach
prompt: Make a three-link arm (three bars 0.4 m long and 0.06 m thick, joined end to end, shoulder at the origin) whose end follows a small yellow ball that a person can pick up and carry around in play mode.
